summary: Auction purchaser rights vs borrower redemption claim under SARFAESI Act; Bank accepting higher post-auction redemption offer; Section 13(8) amendment effect on redemption timing; Sanctity of public auction upheld; High Court interference in SARFAESI matters improper; DRT exclusive jurisdiction; Final bid acceptance precludes subsequent redemption.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court order permitting redemption set aside; Auction purchaser's rights upheld; Secured asset sale confirmed in favour of appellant.
